tokens.name: c-light-sky
tokens.usage: Bright accents and soft fills: behind imagery, decorative waves, illustration backgrounds. Deep Sea text on it reads at 8.54:1.

tokens.name: c-baltic-blue
tokens.usage: Main marine: fills of primary buttons, larger icons, focus rings, navigation indicators. A label on it is c-ink (4.68:1). Not a text colour on c-paper (2.99:1): small text and links use c-baltic-dark.

tokens.name: c-deep-sea
tokens.usage: Heading and strong-text colour: Deep Sea on Paper (11.21:1) by day, warm foam #F6EFD9 in the dark theme (14.26:1). For a dark band or card use surface-strong, which does not invert.

tokens.name: c-sun-yellow
tokens.usage: Sun and energy: highlights, badges, ribbons. Text on it is c-deep-sea (8.35:1) or c-ink (10.41:1), never light.

tokens.name: c-amber
tokens.usage: Warm accent and secondary CTA: golden-hour counterpart to c-sun-yellow. Text on it is c-deep-sea (6.22:1) or c-ink (7.75:1), never light.

tokens.name: c-seafoam
tokens.usage: Calm accent: success states, tags, small graphic elements. A fill or dot only; c-ink on it reads at 6.74:1, but it is not a text colour on c-paper.

tokens.name: c-coral
tokens.usage: CTA colour: booking buttons, key calls to action, script callouts and highlights. Never an error colour. A label on it is c-ink (5.35:1). As text on c-paper it is 2.61:1, so it is for decorative script lines only, never for information.

tokens.name: c-paper
tokens.usage: Dominant background, never pure white. Body text on it: c-ink (13.99:1), c-ink-2 (10.27:1), c-ink-3 (4.97:1), c-deep-sea (11.21:1).

tokens.name: c-ink
tokens.usage: Full-strength dark: labels on accent fills and the on-dark logo ground. Stays dark in both themes, so for running text use fg, which follows the theme. Reads on c-sun-yellow at 10.41:1.

tokens.name: c-paper-2
tokens.usage: Card and slightly recessed surface, a sand-tinted step from c-paper. Text on it: c-ink (13.16:1), c-ink-2 (9.67:1), c-ink-3 (4.67:1), c-deep-sea (10.55:1).

tokens.name: c-paper-3
tokens.usage: Sand band and hover on paper. Text on it: c-ink (11.92:1), c-deep-sea (9.56:1). c-ink-3 on it is 4.23:1, below 4.5:1: use c-ink-2 there.

tokens.name: c-paper-edge
tokens.usage: Paper border and divider. 1.36:1 on c-paper: a quiet hairline, so a control that needs a visible edge uses a c-deep-sea border instead.

tokens.name: c-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on c-paper (10.27:1) and c-paper-2 (9.67:1).

tokens.name: c-ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and captions on c-paper (4.97:1) and c-paper-2 (4.67:1). Not for c-paper-3 (4.23:1).

tokens.name: c-deep-sea-2
tokens.usage: Hover state for c-deep-sea. c-paper text on it reads at 7.74:1.

tokens.name: c-baltic-2
tokens.usage: Hover state for c-baltic-blue fills: one step lighter, so the c-ink label stays readable (7.02:1).

tokens.name: c-baltic-dark
tokens.usage: Baltic for small text: eyebrow labels, text links, the ghost button label. 5.07:1 on c-paper and 4.77:1 on c-paper-2. On c-paper-3 it is 4.32:1, so use c-deep-sea there.

tokens.name: c-sun-2
tokens.usage: Pressed state for c-sun-yellow.

tokens.name: c-coral-2
tokens.usage: Hover state for c-coral fills: one step lighter, so the c-ink label stays readable (6.37:1).

tokens.name: c-sky-wash
tokens.usage: Subtle sky tint for backgrounds and washes. c-deep-sea text on it reads at 10.70:1.

tokens.name: c-sand-wash
tokens.usage: Subtle sand tint for backgrounds and washes. c-deep-sea text on it reads at 10.76:1.

tokens.name: c-foam-wash
tokens.usage: Subtle seafoam tint for backgrounds and washes, behind success badges.

tokens.name: c-brick-red
tokens.usage: Error colour: border of an invalid field, warning icons, the helper line under a field on c-paper (4.75:1). Not for small text on c-paper-2 (4.47:1) or on c-error-wash (4.39:1).

tokens.name: c-error-wash
tokens.usage: Soft background of an error message. Text on it is c-ink (12.93:1), with a c-brick-red icon or border.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas. Never pure white.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Default text on bg, c-paper-2 and c-paper-3. Ink by day, warm paper #E7E2CF in the dark theme (12.63:1).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and c-paper-2.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and captions on bg and c-paper-2. Not for c-paper-3 (4.23:1).

tokens.name: accent-success
tokens.usage: Success states and tags: a fill or dot, with a word or icon beside it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Quiet 1px border on paper surfaces (2px on emphasis cards).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link colour in running text on bg (5.07:1 light, 6.37:1 dark).

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover: colour shifts to Deep Sea and the underline thickens.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Strong band or card: marine cards, dark sections, footer. Deep Sea by day, night-marine in the dark theme (it does not invert). Text on it is on-strong.

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text on surface-strong (11.21:1 light, 12.96:1 dark). Accents on it: c-sun-yellow.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the CTA button (booking, key calls to action). Label is on-accent.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the CTA: one step lighter.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and of a checked checkbox. Label is on-accent.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button: one step lighter.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent fills: action, primary, c-sun-yellow, c-amber. Always dark, in both themes (5.35:1 on Coral in light, 6.12:1 in dark).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Small marine text: eyebrow labels, the ghost button label. 5.07:1 on bg in light, 6.37:1 in dark.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text of a success badge on c-foam-wash (5.46:1 light, 7.70:1 dark).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error colour: border of an invalid field, warning icon, helper line under the field. Never Coral.

tokens.name: error-surface
tokens.usage: Background of an invalid field or an error message. Text on it is fg.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. 5.07:1 on bg in light, 11.80:1 in dark; on surface-strong use c-light-sky in both themes.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page and hero headline, Deep Sea on Paper. Sentence case. On phones (under 640px): 36px, line height 1.15.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headline, Deep Sea on Paper. On phones: 28px.
styles.sample: Pokoje w pawilonach i pokoje rodzinne.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and subsection headline, Deep Sea. On phones: 24px.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Italic lead under a headline, in fg-2. On phones: 20px.
styles.sample: Pięćdziesiąt metrów do plaży. Reszta — Państwa.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small heading in the body face, Deep Sea. On phones: 18px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy and interface text in fg. Never below 16px.
styles.sample: Nasi goście mogą liczyć na dobre wyżywienie i atrakcje dedykowane najmłodszym.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase label in accent-text (or c-deep-sea); the only place ALL CAPS is used (14px and under). Never smaller than 12px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, form helpers and secondary lines in fg-3. Never below 14px.

styles.name: script-callout
styles.usage: Short hand-lettered callout above a headline, 3 to 4 words, in c-coral, tilted about -2deg (30px on inner pages). Always with font-feature-settings "ss01" so the Polish ł/Ł is drawn correctly.

styles.name: script-note
styles.usage: Photo captions, stamps and signatures in the script face (18 to 26px), c-deep-sea on paper or c-paper on a photo. Always with "ss01".

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Smallest step: small gaps; heading to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between controls; heading margin.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph margin; default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Generous card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Largest step: large section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips and helper elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips, tags, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards and larger cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and image masks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary CTA buttons and badges.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Step 1: cards and fields. Tinted with Deep Sea, not black.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Step 2: hover and floating elements.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Step 3: modals and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-sun
tokens.usage: Sun-glow under a hovered or focused CTA.

tokens.name: fs-xs
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels and tiny UI tags.

tokens.name: fs-sm
tokens.usage: Captions and form helpers.

tokens.name: fs-base
tokens.usage: Body. Never below 16px in product surfaces or 24px in slides.

tokens.name: fs-md
tokens.usage: Large body and UI; H4 on phones.

tokens.name: fs-lg
tokens.usage: H4; lede on phones.

tokens.name: fs-xl
tokens.usage: Italic lede; H3 on phones.

tokens.name: fs-5xl
tokens.usage: H1. The largest size in the scale.

tokens.name: fs-h1-mobile
tokens.usage: H1 on phones (under 640px).

tokens.name: fs-h2-mobile
tokens.usage: H2 on phones (under 640px).

tokens.name: lh-snug
tokens.usage: H2, H3, H4, lede, captions.

tokens.name: lh-base
tokens.usage: Body.

tokens.name: tracking-tight
tokens.usage: Display headings.

tokens.name: tracking-caps
tokens.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels, 14px and under.
